aas.cfg.title: AAS Global Configuration
aas.cfg.remote_warning: Connected to a server: changes only affect your local config file.
aas.cfg.ags_projectile_destruction.tip: AGS grenade explosions can destroy blocks.
aas.cfg.ammo_stack_destruction.tip: Destroyed ammo stacks explode and destroy blocks.
aas.cfg.restrict_interactions_to_doors_g: In Survival/Adventure players cannot open chests, barrels, shulker boxes, furnaces, hoppers, dispensers, brewing stands, trapdoors and anvils.
aas.cfg.allow_breaking_defenses.tip: Walls and barbed wire can be broken even when block breaking is prevented.
aas.cfg.prevent_all_item_drops.tip: Players in Survival cannot drop items while the game is running.
aas.cfg.low_tickets_siren.tip: Plays a siren when a team drops to 50 tickets.
aas.cfg.auto_balance_teams.tip: A player cannot join a team that has more players than the other one.
aas.cfg.show_kit_ranks.tip: Shows the level icon between the kit icon and the player name.
aas.cfg.invasion_prep_time_minutes.tip: Preparation time for defenders in Invasion mode.
aas.cfg.vote_auto_start_time.tip: Minutes until the game starts automatically during voting.
aas.cfg.vote_required_percentage.tip: Percentage of team members that must be 'Ready'.
aas.cfg.separate_team_destruction_messag: Chat messages about destroyed HUBs, Rally Points and vehicles go only to the owning team. Spectators and players without a team see both.
aas.cfg.auto_give_sl_radio.tip: Automatically gives a radio to new Squad Leaders.
aas.cfg.require_officer_for_sl.tip: If the squad leader has no Officer kit, the squad disbands after 120 seconds.
aas.cfg.prevent_enemy_vehicle_entry.tip: Players cannot enter vehicles claimed by the enemy team.
aas.cfg.require_specialist_to_drive.tip: Only Pilots can fly and only Mechanics can drive heavy vehicles. Others are kicked from the driver seat after 5 seconds.
aas.cfg.prevent_vehicle_inventory_access: Completely blocks access to the vehicle inventory (Shift+RMB from outside, E from inside).
aas.cfg.one_ammo_bag_per_player.tip: Players cannot carry more than one Ammo Bag at a time.
aas.cfg.require_rifleman_for_ammo_bag.ti: Only players with the Rifleman kit can pick up an Ammo Bag. Creative mode ignores this.
aas.cfg.voice_local_range.tip: Local voice chat (V) range in blocks.
aas.cfg.enable_knockout.tip: Enables the knockout and revive mechanic.
aas.cfg.revive_item.tip: Registry name of the item used to revive, e.g. minecraft:paper.
aas.cfg.revive_cooldown_seconds.tip: Seconds during which dying again results in instant death.
aas.cfg.revive_hold_seconds.tip: Seconds a non-medic must hold the revive key.
aas.cfg.medic_revive_hold_seconds.tip: Seconds a player with the Medic kit must hold the revive key.
aas.cfg.max_downed_time_seconds.tip: Max time in downed state before bleeding out.
aas.cfg.main_supply_healing.tip: Gives regeneration near the Main Base.
aas.cfg.main_supply_heal_radius.tip: Radius of main base healing, in blocks.
aas.cfg.hub_resupply_cost.tip: Material cost of a kit resupply.
aas.cfg.hub_spawn_costs_materials.tip: Spawning at a FOB costs materials.
aas.cfg.hub_spawn_material_cost.tip: Materials taken when spawning at a FOB.
aas.cfg.hub_placement_requires_crate.tip: Placing a FOB requires a Supply Crate nearby. The crate is consumed and gives 0 materials to the FOB.
aas.cfg.supply_truck_crates.tip: Max supply crates in a truck.
aas.cfg.supply_crate_materials.tip: Materials in each dropped supply crate.
aas.cfg.rifleman_crate_resupply_cost.tip: Cost of a Rifleman resupply from a crate or vehicle. If there are fewer materials, the resupply is refused.
aas.cfg.rifleman_hub_cost_multiplier.tip: Multiplier of the resupply cost when Rifleman resupplies at a Hub/FOB.
aas.cfg.sapper_crate_resupply_cost.tip: Cost of a Sapper resupply from a Supply Crate. If there are fewer materials, the resupply is refused.
aas.cfg.sapper_vehicle_resupply_cost.tip: Cost of a Sapper resupply from a vehicle. If there are fewer materials, the resupply is refused.
aas.cfg.sapper_hub_cost_multiplier.tip: Multiplier of the resupply cost when Sapper resupplies at a Hub/FOB.
aas.cfg.drone_operator_crate_resupply_co: Cost of a Drone Operator resupply from a Supply Crate. If there are fewer materials, the resupply is refused.
aas.cfg.drone_operator_vehicle_resupply_: Cost of a Drone Operator resupply from a vehicle. If there are fewer materials, the resupply is refused.
aas.cfg.drone_operator_hub_cost_multipli: Multiplier of the resupply cost when Drone Operator resupplies at a Hub/FOB.
aas.cfg.min_hub_distance.tip: Minimum distance between HUBs, in blocks.
aas.cfg.min_rally_point_distance.tip: Minimum distance between Rally Points, in blocks.
aas.cfg.hub_block_radius.tip: Radius (blocks) in which enemies are counted to block a HUB.
aas.cfg.rally_block_radius.tip: Radius (blocks) in which enemies are counted to block a Rally Point.
aas.cfg.hub_sound_radius.tip: Radius in blocks where HUB sounds can be heard.
aas.cfg.hub_build_radius.tip: Building is allowed within this distance of a friendly or neutral HUB.
aas.cfg.crate_build_radius.tip: Building is allowed within this distance of a friendly or neutral Supply Crate.
aas.cfg.hub_block_enemy_count.tip: Number of nearby enemies needed to block a HUB.
aas.cfg.rally_block_enemy_count.tip: Number of nearby enemies needed to block a Rally Point.
aas.cfg.art_request_cooldown_seconds.tip: Personal cooldown of each squad leader for throwing a request. Starts when the request is confirmed.
aas.cfg.art_strike_cooldown_minutes.tip: Cooldown of the artillery strike itself, shared by the whole team. Starts when the CMD launches a strike.
aas.cfg.art_initial_cooldown_minutes.tip: Strike cooldown of each team at match start. 0 = the CMD can fire at once.
aas.cfg.art_request_radius.tip: Radius of the request circle on the map. 37.5 = 75 blocks diameter. Strikes must lie inside it.
aas.cfg.art_request_max_distance.tip: How far an SL can throw a request with the ping menu (blocks). Server-side raycast over loaded chunks.
aas.cfg.art_request_confirm_seconds.tip: Time the SL has to confirm a new request. Afterwards it is cancelled without cooldown.
aas.cfg.art_request_lifetime_seconds.tip: Lifetime of a confirmed request until it is used.
aas.cfg.art_shell_spawn_height.tip: Y at which shells are spawned (limited to the top of the world).
aas.cfg.art_silence_seconds.tip: Silence between the spotting shots and the first salvo.
aas.cfg.art_salvo_seconds.tip: Length of one salvo. There are 3 salvos.
aas.cfg.art_circle_spot_shells.tip: CIRCLE strike: number of spotting shells.
aas.cfg.art_circle_salvo_shells.tip: CIRCLE strike: shells per salvo (3 salvos). Independent of the radius: bigger circle = thinner fire.
aas.cfg.art_rect_spot_shells.tip: RECTANGLE strike: number of spotting shells.
aas.cfg.art_rect_salvo_shells.tip: RECTANGLE strike: shells per salvo (3 passes). Independent of the rectangle size.
aas.cfg.art_circle_min_radius.tip: CIRCLE strike: min radius in blocks.
aas.cfg.art_circle_max_radius.tip: CIRCLE strike: max radius in blocks. Also limited by the request radius.
aas.cfg.art_rect_min_length.tip: RECTANGLE strike: min length in blocks.
aas.cfg.art_rect_max_length.tip: RECTANGLE strike: max length in blocks. Also limited by the request circle.
aas.cfg.art_rect_min_width.tip: RECTANGLE strike: min width in blocks.
aas.cfg.art_rect_max_width.tip: RECTANGLE strike: max width in blocks. Also limited by the request circle.
aas.cfg.uav_cooldown_seconds.tip: Recon UAV cooldown. Starts at match start and after the UAV is shot down or expires.
aas.cfg.uav_min_radius.tip: Min radius of the UAV flight zone (blocks).
aas.cfg.uav_max_radius.tip: Max radius of the UAV flight zone (blocks).
aas.cfg.uav_altitude.tip: Altitude above the average terrain height inside the zone (blocks).
aas.cfg.uav_speed.tip: Flight speed in blocks per tick (1.0 = 20 blocks/s).
aas.cfg.uav_zoom_fov.tip: FOV in degrees for the 3 zoom stages, from weakest to strongest. Enter 3 numbers separated by commas, e.g. 45, 25, 10.
aas.cfg.uav_max_tilt.tip: Max camera deviation from the vertical while looking through the UAV (degrees).
aas.cfg.blue_team_custom_name.tip: Custom display name of the blue team.
aas.cfg.red_team_custom_name.tip: Custom display name of the red team.
aas.cfg.compass_scale.tip: Scale of the HUD compass: 1 = Small, 2 = Normal, 3 = Large. Client-side setting.
